ICS 23.040.70PCD131. Scope1.1 This standard prescribes general requirements and methods of test for those cellular rubber products known as latex foam rubber products.1.2 It does not cover article made from shredded latex foam, or articles consisting of a cover enclosing loose pieces of latex foam products. It also does not apply to sponge and expanded rubbers2. ReferencesThe following standards contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:IS No. Title264 : 2005 Nitric acid265 : 1993 Hydrochloric acid266 : 1993 Sulphuric acid915 : 2006 One mark graduated flasks1070 : 1992 Water, distilled quality (revised)
